title: Parse Server before 8.6.122 and 9.0.0 before 9.11.1-alpha.2 does not prevent dot notation keys from changing a field…
description: Parse Server versions before 8.6.122 and 9.0.0 before 9.11.1-alpha.2 allow modification of certain fields using dot notation keys, bypassing beforeSave trigger protections. This affects Object, Array, GeoPoint, Polygon, Bytes (on MongoDB), and ACL fields during create and update operations. An authorized client can exploit this to alter fields intended to remain constant, potentially bypassing Cloud Code authorization checks.
